description: The area within a time budget of a location, as GeoJSON contours (metered: 10 tokens per contour). By default, the area that can reach the location; set direction='from' for the area reachable from it. Give block_geoid or lat+lon. Defaults to a single 30-minute contour; ask for more only when needed (bodies can be large).

block_geoid.description: 15-digit census block GEOID of a single origin.

contours.description: Up to four ascending thresholds, instead of minutes.

direction.description: 'to' (default): the area that can reach the origin. 'from': the area reachable from the origin.

name: isochrone
